fine_lines.title: I can't vs I won't be able to
fine_lines.explanation_ar: I won't be able to أكثر تهذيبًا ورسمية من I can't، خاصة عند رفض دعوة في المستقبل.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "I won't be able to" is softer and more formal than "I can't", especially to refuse a future invitation.

examples.sentence: I'm really sorry, I won't be able to come tomorrow.

fine_lines.title: appropriate vs inappropriate
fine_lines.explanation_ar: appropriate = مناسب، و inappropriate = غير مناسب. البادئة in- تعطي المعنى العكسي.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Appropriate" means suitable; "inappropriate" means not suitable. The prefix in- makes the opposite.

examples.sentence: A suit is appropriate for an interview.

grammar.title: Structure of a polite refusal
grammar.explanation_ar: الرفض المهذب له خطوات: (1) اشكر: Thank you for your offer. (2) اعتذر وارفض بلطف: I'm really sorry, I won't be able to. (3) اذكر السبب: I'm afraid... (4) اختم: With regret, I'm going to have to say no.
grammar.explanation_en: A polite refusal has steps: (1) thank: "Thank you for your offer." (2) apologise and say no softly: "I'm really sorry, I won't be able to." (3) give a reason: "I'm afraid..." (4) close: "With regret, I'm going to have to say no."
examples: Thank you for your offer, but I'm really sorry, I won't be able to.
I'm afraid it's against company policy.
So, with regret, I'm going to have to say no.

grammar.title: would for softer statements
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم wouldn't + الفعل الأساسي لجعل الجملة أقل حدة: It wouldn't be appropriate أكثر لطفًا من It isn't appropriate.
grammar.explanation_en: Use "wouldn't + base verb" to make a statement softer: "It wouldn't be appropriate" is gentler than "It isn't appropriate".
examples: That wouldn't be possible, I'm afraid.
It would be better to meet in the office.
